traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and requirements of docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md are fully implemented and verified: - Core functionality: The valid-annotation-format ESLint rule and its helpers validate @story and @req syntax and format, including multi-line annotations, via regex-based patterns and explicit validators (validateStoryAnnotation, validateReqAnnotation, finalizePendingAnnotation). Tests cover valid and invalid cases for both tags. - Quality standards: The rule follows ESLint best practices with meta (type, docs, messages, schema, fixable), JSON Schema-based options, and robust option resolution with error reporting. RuleTester-based unit tests and plugin/config integration tests all pass. - Integration: The rule is exported from src/index.ts and enabled in recommended/strict configs alongside function and branch rules, meaning it operates on the same annotations detected by those rules. The Program visitor inspects all comments at file level, so it naturally complements function and branch validation. - User experience: Error messages are specific and actionable, differentiating missing vs invalid values and including example paths/IDs. Tests assert exact message strings for a wide variety of failure scenarios, ensuring clarity and consistency. - Error handling: The implementation handles malformed comments, empty values, invalid regex configurations, unsafe paths (with traversal), and other edge cases gracefully, either by emitting clear diagnostics or by skipping unsafe auto-fixes. Edge-case tests and performance tests confirm stable behavior under stress. - Documentation: The story itself provides canonical examples, and the implementation bakes these into defaults and error messages, which are asserted in tests. This effectively serves as an executable format specification. Given the direct traceability annotations to this story throughout the relevant code, the comprehensive and passing test coverage, and the explicit alignment with each requirement, this story is assessed as PASSED.
